title: EmailDraft
description: Output contract for prompts/03-email-draft.md. claims_used is the verification contract with the reviewer judge.

subject.description: Under 6 words, lowercase-casual, specific to the recipient, no spam-trigger words.

body.description: Under 120 words. No signature block, unsubscribe line, or postal address (the sender appends those).

opener_type.description: research_hook only when hook.found=true and hook_quality >= 4.

claims_used.description: Every factual claim in the draft, each mapped to the input field it came from. A claim in the body that is missing here is an automatic reviewer fail.

claim.description: The claim as it appears (or is paraphrased) in the draft.

source_field.description: The input field or knowledge-base chunk id that supports it.

word_count.description: Word count of body (also re-checked deterministically downstream).
